name: Parking Facilities
description: Parking facility locations, capacity, and occupancy

dataSources.purpose: Real-time parking lot availability across European cities
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (static city list endpoint); city name for lot retrieval
dataSources.dataReceived: City list with coordinates and source info; per-city lots with name, address, coordinates, total/free capacity

dataSources.purpose: German parking sites with real-time occupancy data
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire dataset); site ID for detail lookup
dataSources.dataReceived: Parking sites with name, address, coordinates, capacity, realtime free capacity, type, fee info, opening hours

dataSources.purpose: Deutsche Bahn station parking facilities
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire dataset); facility ID for detail lookup
dataSources.dataReceived: Parking facilities with name, address, coordinates, capacity, tariff/pricing, accessibility, EV charging info

dataSources.purpose: Netherlands parking garages, Park & Ride, and carpool facilities
dataSources.dataSent: Bounding box coordinates for geographic filtering; area manager ID and area ID for detail lookup
dataSources.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, type (garage/P+R/carpool), capacity, EV charging point count, disabled access flag, max vehicle height

dataSources.purpose: French parking facilities from the national BNLS register
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire dataset)
dataSources.dataReceived: Facility ID, name, coordinates, total spaces, free/paid status, facility type, hourly/daily/monthly pricing, disabled/EV/P+R space counts, max height, address

dataSources.purpose: Real-time parking garage occupancy in Ghent, Belgium
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire dataset)
dataSources.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, total/available capacity, occupancy percentage, open/closed status, occupancy trend, operator

dataSources.purpose: Static parking facility data for Brussels, Belgium
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire dataset)
dataSources.dataReceived: Facility name (FR/NL), coordinates, capacity, disabled capacity, max height, floors, operator, address

dataSources.purpose: Real-time parking garage occupancy in Basel, Switzerland
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire dataset)
dataSources.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, free/total spaces, address

dataSources.purpose: Real-time parking availability in Florence, Italy
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire dataset)
dataSources.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, free spaces count, last update timestamp

dataSources.purpose: Static parking facility data for Barcelona, Spain
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire dataset)
dataSources.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, address, district, neighborhood, status

dataSources.purpose: Static parking garages and P+R facilities in Vienna, Austria
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire WFS dataset)
dataSources.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, operator, address, P+R flag, disabled access flag, website

dataSources.purpose: Static parking garage data for Copenhagen, Denmark
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire WFS dataset)
dataSources.dataReceived: Street name, house number, postal district, capacity, type (underground/garage), owner

dataSources.purpose: Real-time car park availability across Singapore
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire availability + static datasets)
dataSources.dataReceived: Car park number, lot type, total/available lots, address, coordinates (SVY21 converted to WGS84), car park type

dataSources.purpose: Static parking facility data for Madrid, Spain
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire dataset)
dataSources.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, address, capacity (from description), schedule, P+R designation, operator

dataSources.purpose: Real-time car park data for Newcastle/Tyne & Wear, UK
dataSources.dataSent: UTMC credentials (username/password) for authentication
dataSources.dataReceived: Car park name, coordinates, capacity, free spaces, state (open/closed/full)

dataSources.purpose: Real-time Park & Ride car park data for Greater Sydney, Australia
dataSources.dataSent: NSW Transport API key for authentication
dataSources.dataReceived: Facility name, coordinates, capacity, available spaces, occupancy

dataSources.purpose: Real-time truck parking availability along Dutch highways
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire static table + dynamic status XML feeds)
dataSources.dataReceived: Truck parking facilities with name, coordinates, capacity, real-time vacant/occupied spaces, amenities (charging, toilet, shower)

dataSources.purpose: German Autobahn rest area and truck parking facilities
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches road list, then parking data per road)
dataSources.dataReceived: Rest area name, coordinates, car/truck parking capacity, blocked status, amenities (toilet, fuel, restaurant, WiFi, shower)

dataSources.purpose: Parking stations in South Tyrol, Italy
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire station list + latest measurements)
dataSources.dataReceived: Station name (multilingual), coordinates, capacity, real-time occupied/free spaces, parking layout type, EV charging availability

dataSources.purpose: NRW Mobidrom bundled parking data (Düsseldorf, Köln, Bielefeld, Krefeld, Wuppertal, Aachen plus operator static data)
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire aggregate DATEX II Parking Light feed)
dataSources.dataReceived: Parking site name, coordinates, capacity, real-time availability, occupancy trend, parking type, fee/tariff, opening hours, address, disabled and EV assignments

dataSources.purpose: NRW Mobidrom bundled Park+Ride data (VRR, Bielefeld, Bonn, Köln, Münster, Oberhausen)
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire aggregate DATEX II Parking Light feed)
dataSources.dataReceived: Park+Ride site name, coordinates, capacity, real-time availability where provided, fee info, address; every record flagged as P+R

dataSources.purpose: APCOA Deutschland parking facilities via NRW Mobidrom
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches operator feed)

dataSources.purpose: APAG Aachener Parkhaus real-time garage data via NRW Mobidrom
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches operator feed)
dataSources.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, capacity, real-time available spaces, occupancy trend, address, tariff info, equipment tags

dataSources.purpose: GOLDBECK Parking Services static garage data via NRW Mobidrom
dataSources.dataSent: No user data (fetches operator feed)
dataSources.dataReceived: Garage name, coordinates, address, tariff info, opening hours

dataSources.purpose: Parking facilities from OpenStreetMap (static data, no real-time availability)
